content_sections.heading: APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Vijayawada has released the Brief Notifications for various posts under different subordinate services of the Andhra Pradesh Government on 15 September 2026. The APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 notification includes a total of 299 provisional vacancies for posts such as Executive Officer Grade-III, Forest Range Officer, Forest Section Officer, Forest Beat Officer, Draughtsman Grade-II, District Probation Officer Grade-II, Industrial Promotion Officer and Supervisor Grade-I. Candidates can download the APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF from the official website of APPSC at psc.ap.gov.in. The Detailed Notification containing complete vacancy details, age limit, application fee, reservation details and other instructions will be released on or before 16 October 2026. The online application process will start from 16 October 2026 and eligible candidates can submit their applications online up to 5 November 2026 (11:59 PM). content_sections.heading: APPSC Various Posts Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 299 provisional vacancies are spread across the following 8 posts. The Commission has explicitly noted in each notification that the number of vacancies is subject to variation upon confirmation from the concerned department. All eight are General Recruitment notifications, with the Supervisor Grade-I post reserved exclusively for women candidates, as specified in its notification.

content_sections.text: For all eight posts, the notification states that applicants must possess the requisite educational qualification as on the date of the Detailed Notification.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Various Posts Selection Process
content_sections.text: As stated in each of the notifications, selection for all 8 posts will be through a single-level examination only - no Screening Test will be conducted, irrespective of the number of applications received. The examination will be conducted in online Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. Where the single-level examination is held in multiple sessions, the Commission will apply a normalisation process to the marks, wherever considered necessary and applicable, as per a methodology to be notified by the Commission in due course. For the Executive Officer Grade-III post, the notification additionally specifies the following examination scheme (as per Annexure-V of G.O.Ms.No.201, Finance (HR-I Plg. & Policy) Dept., dated 21/12/2017): For this post, each wrong answer is penalised with 1/3rd of the marks prescribed for that question, as per G.O.Ms. No.235, Finance (HR-I, Plg & Policy) Dept., dated 06/12/2016. The detailed scheme and syllabus for each post's examination is annexed to its respective notification; candidates should refer to the specific notification for their post to see the complete subject-wise syllabus.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only, through the Commission's website psc.ap.gov.in , between 16 October 2026 and 5 November 2026 (up to 11:59 PM). Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online mode will not be entertained under any circumstances. Candidates should read the Commission's Detailed Notification and other instructions carefully before applying, and enter their particulars correctly in the online application form. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the last date to avoid last-minute rush.

faq.question: Q1. What is APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a set of 8 Brief Notifications (Nos. 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18, 23, and 24 of 2026), all dated 15 September 2026, issued by the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission for direct recruitment to 299 posts across 8 different Andhra Pradesh subordinate services.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 299 provisional vacancies: 104 Executive Officer Grade-III, 78 Industrial Promotion Officer, 29 Supervisor Grade-I, 26 Forest Section Officer, 23 Forest Beat Officer, 20 Draughtsman Grade-II, 15 District Probation Officer Grade-II, and 4 Forest Range Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 5 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for APPSC Various Posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post — from Intermediate pass (Forest Beat Officer) and an ITI trade certificate (Draughtsman Grade-II) to specific Bachelor's/Master's degrees for the remaining posts. See the Qualification section above for the complete post-wise breakup.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply online for APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only at psc.ap.gov.in between 16 October 2026 and 5 November 2026, as described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the APPSC selection process?
faq.answer: Selection for each post is through a single-level online (CBRT) examination only, with no separate Screening Test; marks may be normalised if the exam is held in multiple sessions, as explained in the Selection Process section above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for APPSC Various Posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from ₹25,220–₹80,910 (Executive Officer Grade-III and Forest Beat Officer) to ₹54,060–₹1,40,540 (Industrial Promotion Officer), depending on the post. See the Salary section above for the complete breakup.
